title: PPS RFID Laundry Tags
description: PPS RFID laundry tags for high-temperature industrial laundry tracking, built as durable button-style tags for linen, garments and textile circulation.

summary: PPS RFID laundry tags are hard button-style tags built for industrial washing environments where temperature, chemicals and mechanical stress are too harsh for lighter tag formats.
Crafted from integrated injection moulding, the RFID unit and the plastic material melted into a single entity, forms into very stable structure.
Designed for harsh environments, the PPS Laundry Tag is fully waterproof and resistant to most detergents and cleaning chemicals.

faq.question: What are PPS RFID Laundry Tags commonly used for?
faq.answer: Best for industrial laundry programs that need a hard, button-style RFID tag able to survive repeated washing, drying, chemicals and heat.

faq.question: Which chip, protocol, or frequency options are available for PPS RFID Laundry Tags?
faq.answer: Chip: Icode-slix or slix2 Protocol: 15693 TYPE 5 protocol Frequency: 13.56MHZ Read Range: 1.5 – 20cm depending on readers

faq.question: What material or form-factor options are available for PPS RFID Laundry Tags?
faq.answer: Material: PPS Size: ø11mm, ø15mm, ø18mm, ø20mm, ø22mm, ø25mmm, etc.
